title: dispatch starts a worker with TRACEPARENT of its kb.worker span and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES naming its item and sprint, so the worker's own Claude Code telemetry joins the item's trace
goal: dispatch sets in the worker session's environment TRACEPARENT (W3C, version 00, sampled) holding the trace id and span id kbmon --events gives that worker run's kb.worker span, and OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES with kb.item.id and kb.sprint.id added to the entries the dispatching environment already has (values percent-encoded, no email entry kept), so a worker whose operator turned on Claude Code telemetry exports events and spans that carry the item and parent under its kb.worker span

run:
import subprocess, tempfile, os, shutil, re, sys, json, glob
R = os.getcwd(); T = tempfile.mkdtemp(); S = os.path.join(tempfile.mkdtemp(), 'c.sqlite')
env = dict(os.environ, KB_COORD_STORE=S)
def sh(*a): return subprocess.run(a, cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
g = lambda *a: sh('git', '-c', 'user.email=a@b', '-c', 'user.name=n', *a)
g('init', '-q', '.'); g('commit', '-q', '--allow-empty', '-m', 'init')
shutil.copy(R + '/backlog.json', T); os.makedirs(T + '/kb/_self/backlog')
bl = lambda *a: sh(sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, *a)
def c(*a): return subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/coord.py', '--store', S, *a], capture_output=True, text=True)
sp = re.search(r'SP-\w+', bl('new', 'sprint', '--title', 'S', '--goal', 'g').stdout).group(0)
iid = re.search(r'ST-\w+', bl('new', 'story', '--title', 'Planted', '--goal', 'g', '--check', 'python3 -c pass').stdout).group(0)
def plant(status):
    for f in glob.glob(T + '/kb/_self/backlog/*.json'):
        d = json.load(open(f, encoding='utf-8'))
        if d['id'] == sp: d['status'] = 'active'
        if d['id'] == iid: d['status'] = status; d['sprint'] = sp
        json.dump(d, open(f, 'w', encoding='utf-8'), indent=2)
    g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'planted ' + status)
def walk(*states): return [c('transition', 'run/' + iid, '--to', s).returncode for s in states]
from pathlib import Path
plant('todo')
bl('claim', iid, '--by', 'check'); g('add', '-A'); g('commit', '-q', '-m', 'claim')
bd = Path(T + '-bin'); bd.mkdir(); seen = Path(T + '-env.json')
fake = bd / 'claude'
fake.write_text('#!' + sys.executable + '\nimport sys,json,os\nsys.stdin.read()\njson.dump({k: os.environ.get(k, "") for k in '
                '("TRACEPARENT", "OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES")}, open(' + repr(str(seen)) + ', "w"))\n'
                'print(json.dumps(dict(session_id="sess-trace", is_error=False)))\n')
fake.chmod(0o755)
d = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/backlog.py', '--root', T, 'dispatch', iid], cwd=T, capture_output=True, text=True,
                   env=dict(env, PATH=str(bd) + os.pathsep + env['PATH']))
got = json.loads(seen.read_text()) if seen.exists() else {}
tp = re.fullmatch(r'00-([0-9a-f]{32})-([0-9a-f]{16})-01', got.get('TRACEPARENT', ''))
attrs = dict(p.split('=', 1) for p in got.get('OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES', '').split(',') if '=' in p)
ev = subprocess.run([sys.executable, R + '/_tools/kbmon.py', '--events', '--root', T, '--store', S], capture_output=True, text=True, env=env)
try:
    spans = json.loads(ev.stdout)['spans']
except (ValueError, KeyError):
    spans = []
worker = [s for s in spans if s['name'] == 'kb.worker' and s['attributes'].get('item') == iid]
ok = (d.returncode == 0 and tp and attrs.get('kb.item.id') == iid and attrs.get('kb.sprint.id') == sp
      and worker and worker[0]['id'] == tp.group(2) and worker[0]['trace'] == tp.group(1))
print('dispatch', d.returncode, 'TRACEPARENT', got.get('TRACEPARENT'), 'attrs', attrs, 'kb.worker', len(worker))
sys.exit(0 if ok else 1)

gates.question: Does dispatch turn on Claude Code's own telemetry for every worker, or only pass the trace context?
options: only pass TRACEPARENT and the resource attributes; telemetry stays as the operator's environment sets it
also set CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY and the beta traces exporter to a loopback receiver for every worker
neither: kb spans only, no link to Claude Code's telemetry
gates.recommendation: only pass TRACEPARENT and the resource attributes; telemetry stays as the operator's environment sets it
gates.answer: only pass TRACEPARENT and the resource attributes; telemetry stays as the operator's environment sets it

notes: Premise: a stub claude started by dispatch sees no TRACEPARENT and no OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES (the check prints both empty). Live docs, not in the kb (code.claude.com/docs/en/monitoring-usage, read 2026-10-24): in -p and Agent SDK sessions Claude Code reads TRACEPARENT and TRACESTATE from its environment and makes claude_code.interaction a child of that span; its OTLP event records carry that trace_id and span_id even with no traces exporter; traces are beta (CLAUDE_CODE_ENABLE_TELEMETRY=1, CLAUDE_CODE_ENHANCED_TELEMETRY_BETA=1, OTEL_TRACES_EXPORTER); OTEL_RESOURCE_ATTRIBUTES keys go on every metric point and event, values percent-encoded. kbotel.py serve takes /v1/logs only (its EVENT_KEYS allowlist), so a loopback trace receiver is new work if the gate picks it. The span id dispatch passes is computed from the working move's event, so kbmon's kb.worker span gets the same id. Plan 2026-10-24 (SP-d6gbc3tq): gate g1 answered by the operator earlier (pass the context only). Check 1 added: a dispatch env holding team, service.name and a percent-encoded user.email keeps the first two, drops the email entry and adds kb.item.id and kb.sprint.id.
